notes.title: Rocksmith+ has new songs, updates, and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
[h1]2024 Summer 3 Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]Feature improvements / New features[/h2]

[h3]Hub[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added multi-select filtering functionality to the Search Results screen. This will let you select multiple filters of the same type. 
[*] Added filtering and sorting options to the “My Saved Songs”, “Recently Played”, “Greatest Hits”, and “New This Month” song queues.
[*] Updated the “Search” tab in the Hub to include theme, and tuning filters, as well as some artist-based song queues.
[*] Added a new dialogue to explain the perks of subscribing for players who are not subscribed.
[/list]

[h3]Noteway[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new camera option for Guitar / Bass that closely matches the Rocksmith 2014 camera. This camera is now set as default.
[/list]

[h3]Onboarding Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added direct linking functionality to some of our existing onboarding challenges. If you click / tap on challenges that support this, they should take you directly to the content we are asking you to play / watch.
[/list]

[h3]Tones[/h3]
[list]
[*] The tone manager menu that is on the Customize screen is now available when your instrument is set to Piano, so you can try all our tones.
[*] Added a low-latency FM synthesizer that is available in some piano tones.
[*] A new feature has been added called the “Pedal Board”. This works similarly to Rocksmith 2014’s “Tone Stick” where you can save 3 tones to it, and at a moment's notice you can change to those tones inside or outside of a song, overriding your current tone. These tones can be saved to the Pedal Board inside the Tone Manager menu in the Customize tab of the Hub.
[/list]

[h2]Major Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock issue where a blurred screen would appear when pressing "Close" on the Audio input/output screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the phrase banner displayed in Song Details did not match the phrase banner on Noteway's Pause screen.
[*] Updated images used in pop-up after tutorial completion.
[*] Fixed in-game sound distortion issue when booting in Dolby Digital and DTS with Audio Exclusivity turned on.
[*] Fixed an issue where the display would collapse when Edit is pressed on the Customize screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where progress would not be possible when starting a tutorial for a different instrument.
[/list]
[h3]Rocksmith+ Mobile[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem in which the Instrument Sound setting was turned off when an interface (e.g., iRig) was connected while Built-in-Mic is set as the input method.
[*] The login screen has been redesigned. This has fixed overlaps issues between virtual keyboard and the input screen on the login screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with Galaxy Z Fold devices where the video and UI overlapped on the Skill Guide video screen.
[*] Fixed overlap issue with the sort buttons UI on certain iPhone devices.
[/list]

[h3]Song Results[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing "Exit" on the Results screen after finishing playing a song would cause the button to become unresponsive and prevent progress.
[/list]

[h3]Learn[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where, when transitioning from a Lesson Track to a Song, the arrangement would not match.
[/list]

[h3]Connections[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting RTC after connecting with an audio interface using ASIO driver would show RTC as connected even though the interface was connected.
[*] Fixed an issue where disconnecting the RTC cable when connecting to the Rocksmith Tuner would prevent connection between the game and the App.
[/list]

[h3]PlayStation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented filter selection on the Filter dropdown when scrolling down.
[*] Fixed an issue where the highlight would not move to the top when "Go to top" was selected in List View
[*] Fixed the transition issue when clicking the Lesson Portal "Find the right lesson for you”.
[/list]


[h2]Major Known Issues[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] After playing for more than 1 hour, the Search Results screen may be displayed incorrectly when changing instruments, playing a song and then performing a Search.
[*] In Bass’ Skills Guide, the  video for “Unique Chord" can no longer be played.
[/list]

[h3]Search[/h3]
[list]
[*] When selecting "Greatest hits" or "All songs" from the "Search" tab, songs may not be displayed in some cases.
[*] Screen may flicker when returning to the Search screen from Search Categories.
[/list]

[h3]Artist Link Page[/h3]
[list]
[*] After playing a song on the Artist Link Page, videos in Video Queues will no longer play.
[*] When returning to Song Details after playing a song on the Artist Link Page, pressing "<" or ">" may not switch songs.
[/list]

[h3]Customize[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tone can be changed when Override Piano Tones is set to On.
[/list]

[h3]Rocksmith+ Mobile[/h3]
[list]
[*] On iOS, the application may crash if the subscription expires while the game is running.
[/list]

[h3]PlayStation[/h3]
[list]
[*] When changing the Field of View from Options in Pause, the highlight of the item is not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[h3]New Content Playable Now in Rocksmith+![/h3]
Check it out in game, or in our [url=https://open.spotify.com/user/317u3qcdlpy5ydsap7tpwsppem2m?si=180bb4be17f14ae0&nd=1&dlsi=75e30a855d0b4fd5]Spotify Playlist[/url]. 

[h2]New Authentic Arrangements: 27[/h2]
[list]
[*] Korn - A.D.I.D.A.S. - Bass, Lead, Chord Chart
[*] Korn - It's On! - Bass, Lead, Chord Chart

[*] Korn - B.B.K. - Bass, Lead, Chord Chart
[*] Korn - Reclaim My Place - Bass, Lead, Chord Chart
[*] Type O Negative - Christian Woman - Piano
[*] Type O Negative - I Dont Wanna Be Me - Piano
[*] Type O Negative - I Dont Wanna Be Me - Simple Piano

[/list]

Song Availability May Vary by Region

notes.title: Update Note for Sep.3rd
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Noteway Camera is now set to Rocksmith 2014 Noteway Camera by default (Guitar/Bass Only) 
[*] Added the ability to favorite multiple tones, and change to them in the menu or during a song at a moments notice with the addition of the Pedal Board 
[*] The tone manager menu on the Customize screen is now available for Piano 
[*] Added direct linking functionality to existing onboarding challenges 
[*] Added multi-select filter functionality to Search Result including Artist Linking (selecting the artist name in the song details)  
[*] Added local filtering and sorting to My Saved Songs, Recently Played, Greatest Hits, and New This Month song queues in Expanded view 
[*] Updated the Search landing screen, providing theme, tuning, and artist based queues to improve song discovery 
[*] New dialogue reminding unsubscribed players about subscription perks 
[/list]
